subject: c-info
title: C.INFO.------SOC.RT.DY.
description: Chart on book p. 166 (SR(TRS)II-22). C-INFO (composite information) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: COS-P (cosmic particulars) and VT-DY (vibrational dynamics). From VT-DY: PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) and TM (terminology—or terms of a definition), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From PROG-CONT: INFO-DY (information dynamics) and OBS (observation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". PART (participation) is on a dotted line from OBS.
